citation.title: Analysis of edge density fluctuation measured by trial KSTAR beam emission spectroscopy system
citation.authors: Y. U. Nam; S. Zoletnik; M. Lampert; Á. Kovácsik

topic: Trial KSTAR BES (APD camera) design, installation and early edge density-fluctuation observations
own_question: Is a direct-imaging APD BES design feasible on KSTAR, and what edge fluctuation features does the trial system reveal?
actual_method_and_evidence: A 4×8 APD array is digitized at 2 MHz with 12-bit resolution. The paper reports measured photon flux relative to a simulation, along with signal-to-noise and background estimates. Viewing positions were calibrated with a visible camera. The paper presents spectrograms and cross-correlations of raw BES light signals from 2011-campaign shots. Reported observations include low-frequency suppression after the L-H transition, a beam-dependent broad peak at roughly 10–20 kHz, and an 8 µs delay between poloidal channels. The authors interpret this delay as poloidal rotation. These results are qualitative trial-system observations, not calibrated density.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR has a BES diagnostic that images beam emission with a 2D APD array at MHz sampling, sensitive to edge density fluctuations.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2 Sec. II, Fig. 2 caption area
claim_checks.qualification: This was the 2011 trial system. The 2022 configuration may differ, and the measured signal is light intensity, not calibrated ne.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Trial BES spectrograms showed edge fluctuation changes around L-H transitions and a 10–20 kHz peak whose frequency the authors relate to edge Te trends.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.3 Fig. 3; p.4 Sec. IV, Fig. 4
claim_checks.qualification: The data are limited and the peak's nature is unidentified (GAM is only proposed). Fluctuation content below 10 kHz includes background contamination. Figures were not visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The source reports 2 MHz raw BES sampling with data transfer after shot. CES appears only as an offline position cross-check, and no CES report timing is given.
validation_if_relevant: Feasibility comparison against simulation on a few shots only; no predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer that BES predicts or nowcasts CES temperature.
Do not equate the 2011 trial hardware with the KSTAR2022 system.
Do not cite this paper as establishing a physical mechanism (GAM, rotation) relating fluctuations to Ti.
Do not claim real-time BES processing was demonstrated.
Do not equate the BES-related Te trend with the impurity CES Ti signal.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful as a diagnostic-background citation for the KSTAR BES input and its edge-fluctuation sensitivity. It is not evidence for the nowcasting results.
